items.item:
5. Activating a version whose proof failed because its binding was `proposed`
   is refused with that proof failure; after the owner accepts the binding, the
   owner activating the same version succeeds with no new version.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a06_activation_proves_version_again]
statements:
```text
flow_activation -> proven(flow_version) at activation
highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
agent_asks(effectful) -> refused AND nothing_kept
new_flow_version -/> inherits(activation | grant | approval)
```

```text

highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
```

verdicts.why: The check asserts that activation of the version with a proposed-binding proof failure is refused without activation, then that owner activation of the same effectful version succeeds after acceptance and no new version exists. It does not assert read-only activation by the kernel, agent refusal with nothing kept, or that a new flow version inherits no activation, grant, or approval.
